name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Add a "safe-change" flag to every prompt that lets us auto-apply edits when the diff is under 10 lines and passes a quick syntax check. This cuts review time for trivial fixes without risking big rewrites. The trade-off is we might miss subtle context shifts in longer edits, so we keep the flag off by default and log every auto-apply for later spot-checks.

name: Gauge
text: The "safe-change" flag risks normalizing sloppy edits—10 lines is arbitrary, and syntax checks miss semantic drift. Better: auto-apply only when the diff is a single-line tweak *and* the change is a known safe pattern (e.g., typo fixes, doc updates). Settle it by running a 2-week trial on non-critical files and measuring how often auto-applied changes require rollback.
